content.short: EAE plans to be one of the first multi-blockchain NFT projects, creating a curated NFT launch platform with the funds collected.
content.description:
Evil Ape Empire, a new NFT collection set to launch on Cardano, Solana and Ethereum is here to set a standard in terms of community friendliness, art and events and giveaways for people that partake in their community. With some ambitious plans, the Evil Ape Empire seeks to take over dominance in all three NFT markets, Cardano being their first target. One of their ambitious plans is to launch a curated NFT launch platform after having released their three collections. The platform will serve as a hub where NFTs can be staked, and through the staking protocol one can get access to different tiers of accessing new NFT launches on the platform. Essentially this is quite similar to token launch platforms, but specific to NFTs and they want to focus on community building rather than pumping out as many projects as they can. The community has very quickly grown and the OG sale on Cardano sold out very quickly! The Empire has a collection of 100 so called 'OG' apes on each chain, all with their own unique traits. These traits do not appear in the main collections, and the OG apes get you access to exclusive giveaways such as winning games, fan art and even money. By owning an OG ape one gets access to the whitelist for all drops that have yet to come. On top of that one can join the communities' giveaways and events, such as Flex Your Ape and Ape VS Ape where there are great prizes and these are recurring events.​ Each main collection consists of 6666 Evil Apes, all with randomized traits selected from over 300 different options! Every blockchain also comes with an OG collection of 100 OG Apes. The way EAE intends to fund all these goals comes from: Initial NFT drop sales --> Pays for ads costs, the team etc. Royalties on every collection --> Pays for any ads, promos needed right away. Merchandise sales --> Funneled into platform / staking fund. Token investors that will invest into the future EAE token launch --> Funneled into platform / staking fund.
